core.title: Offset Stainless Steel Shower Handles, Pair,  AHI SD-SIG413-630

text.description_html:
AHI SIG413-630 Contemporary Offset Stainless Steel Shower Handles

These 9-1/4 inch contemporary offset shower door handles are made of solid stainless steel by AHI Hardware, a leader in stainless door hardware. It has a warm Satin Stainless Steel finish for a truly eye catching contemporary design. The contoured grip handle center is approximately 1-1/4 inch with a 1 inch offset. Packaged with glass shower door mounting kit. They requiring little maintenance, designed to enhance any setting where a modern, sophisticated look is desired.

Specifications for the AHI SD-SIG413 Offset Shower Handle Set:

  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Total Length: 9-9/16" (243 mm)
  • Mounting Centers: 8-3/8" (213 mm)
  • Projection: 3" (76 mm)
  • Door Mounting: 1/4" to 1/2" thick glass doors.

Packaged with 2 door pulls and mounting hardware for back to back mounting on 1/4" to 1/2" thick glass shower doors.



** This item is Discontinued. See available Glass Door Pulls
